purpose: Provide a privacy-bounded, source-bound intake contract for authorized educational and classroom usability review without recording human findings in this preparation packet.
review_questions: Can a first-time player identify how to launch or load a session and what to do next without implementation knowledge?
Can a first-time player complete the seven competitive first-month handoffs while distinguishing draft, validation, submission, and committed resolution?
Can a player recover from rejection or an unavailable read without losing work, inventing an outcome, or needing hidden-state instruction?
Can a player recognize the five campaign-coverage orientation stages and distinguish a host-shaped decision from a local prediction?
Do text, keyboard, reduced-motion, audio-off, cues-only, Large text, skip, and review accommodations preserve the same visible meaning?
Can a reviewer distinguish early, middle, and terminal facility and operational-pressure states without relying on color, motion, or audio alone?
Can a reviewer trace a visible committed consequence across board, facility, overlay, event, resolution, history, and debrief surfaces without inferring hidden state or causal certainty?
Can a reviewer distinguish host-supplied public rival observations and uncertainty from private rival intent, resolved inputs, or future outcomes?
Can a reviewer use history, replay, and checkpoint controls to reconstruct visible campaign continuity without mistaking review for mutation?
Do written equivalents, audio-off or cues-only, reduced motion, Large text, keyboard, skip/review, and retry preserve decision-relevant meaning across the full campaign?
Does the current competitive campaign provide enough visual/audio comprehension and trust to justify expansion review, or should the scope remain bounded?
Can a reviewer distinguish committed campaign history from the retrospective debrief without relying on color, motion, or audio?
Can a reviewer reconstruct the visible consequence sequence from written history, debrief, and direct effects without inferring hidden state or causal certainty?
Can a reviewer locate the current stage, terminal status, and absence of further decision controls at the planned 1024x768 baseline?
Do Large text, reduced motion, keyboard navigation, recovery guidance, audio-off, mute, and cues-only preserve decision-relevant meaning?
Are actor-visible observations, uncertainty, written fallbacks, and provenance boundaries understandable without exposing private or instructor-only state?

source_contract.pilot_preparation: docs/evaluation/phase13.2-pilot-preparation-boundary.json: "feedback": "Tasks, rating dimensions, response states, finding categories, and pending decision fields are structured in a checked-in instrument."

forbidden_fields: private game state or hidden rival actions
screenshots, recordings, or raw transcripts without separate consent

evidence_limits: This packet contains no human findings and does not perform or represent educational, classroom, accessibility, or audio-listening review.
The bounded record vocabulary does not establish comprehension, learning, classroom effectiveness, universal accessibility, audio usefulness, legal/provenance clearance, or policy validity.
Technical source parity and an empty intake are preparation evidence only; they do not substitute for authorized participant review or a decision.
Human review, revision decisions, expansion approval, legal/provenance clearance, and public-release approval remain separate authorization gates.
